TEXT.English: The unit goes to your city with the lowest happiness surplus (happy minus unhappy citizens), counting the units already on their way there with this order; among equals, the city that grows soonest. There it fortifies. A selected group goes together; select one unit to send only that one. Only while military units in a city make it happier (Hereditary Rule).
